lines.en: Seventy miles an hour
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
lines.cn: 先听这段录音，然后再回答这个问题。

lines.en: What does Ann advise her husband to do next time?
lines.cn: 安建议她丈夫下次该怎么做？

lines.en: Look, Gary!
That policeman's waving to you.
lines.cn: 那个警察正在向你挥手。

lines.en: He wants you to stop.
Where do you think you are?
On a race track?
You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
lines.cn: 你当时肯定是以每小时70英里的速度在开车。

lines.en: I can't have been.
I was doing eighty when I overtook you.
lines.cn: 当我超过你的时候，我的速度是每小时八十公里。

lines.en: Didn't you see the speed limit?
I'm afraid I didn't, officer.
I must have been dreaming.
He wasn't dreaming, officer.
I was telling him to drive slowly.
lines.cn: 我当时在告诉他要开慢一点。

lines.en: That's why I didn't see the sign.
lines.cn: 这就是为什么我没有看到那个标志的原因。

lines.en: Let me see your driving licence.
lines.cn: 请让我看一下你的驾驶执照。

lines.en: I won't charge you this time.
But you'd better not do it again!
lines.cn: 但你最好别再这么做了！

lines.en: Thank you.
I'll certainly be more careful.
I told you to drive slowly, Gary.
lines.cn: 我早就告诉过你要开慢一点，加里。

lines.en: You always tell me to drive slowly, darling.
lines.cn: 你总是让我开慢车，亲爱的。

lines.en: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
lines.cn: 嗯，下次你最好还是听我的建议吧！
